People: Greta, Jonah, Hugo, Opal (out, Pia covering), Mira, Kira, Dell, Una, Leon, Esme, Rafe, Nils, Pia, Suri, Ada, Teo, Cora, Finn, Ines, Bram, Wren, Vik (out, Rafe covering).

Projects: Ellbury headcap 9,400. Ellford headcap 5,500. Lunley mileage cap 3,975. Lunley fuel allowance 6,350. Orlby mileage cap 6,550.

Locations/Conditions: Lifts near north office, garden studio, library annex, loading bay, harbour room, east wing, and print room are slow. Garden studio, print room, harbour room, north office clear for visitors. Coffee machines work in library annex, harbour room, north office, east wing, loading bay, print room. Umbrellas in print room, harbour room, library annex, north office, east wing, loading bay, garden studio. Harbour room cold mornings/evenings; repainting causes morning/afternoon/evening noise. North office cold afternoons/evenings; repainting causes afternoon noise. Garden studio repainting causes evening noise. Leon/Dell prefer loading bay. Rafe, Nils, Kira, Wren think loading bay/east wing too cold. Wren thinks east wing too cold in morning. Kira thinks print room too cold in evening. Greta thinks library annex too cold in evening. Esme thinks print room too cold in evening. Library annex repainting causes evening/morning noise. Morning stand-up moved to north office. Evening stand-up moved to print room. Afternoon stand-up moved to north office. Mira thinks loading bay too cold in morning. Finn thinks loading bay too cold in afternoon. Una thinks loading bay too cold in morning. Print room repainting causes afternoon noise. East wing repainting causes afternoon noise. Finn thinks garden studio too cold in morning. Cora thinks print room too cold in morning. Ines thinks garden studio too cold in afternoon. Leon thinks garden studio too cold in morning. Nils thinks garden studio too cold in morning. Pia prefers east wing for reviews.
